name: Nuclear plant safety
value: IAEA warns on Ukraine grid in winter
summary: IAEA chief warns of rising safety risks at Zaporizhzhia and Ukraine's grid as winter sets in; no safety-system damage
state: IAEA Director General Rafael Grossi told the agency's Board on 18 Nov that it would be difficult to overstate his concern about Ukraine's power grid as winter sets in (ANS, 19 Nov), and warned that nuclear safety risks at Zaporizhzhia may increase over the winter (APA). Repeated losses of off-site power at the plant this year keep Watch. Searches on 26 Nov found no damage to safety-critical systems, INES level 2 event or radiological release.
for_you: No action is needed by the public outside Ukraine; follow the IAEA and national authorities for any change in the safety situation.
rubric_hit: IAEA reports a deteriorating safety situation and off-site power losses = Watch; no safety-system damage

sources.title: American Nuclear Society — IAEA, Grossi give updates on Ukraine, Iran, North Korea
APA — Grossi: nuclear safety risks at Zaporizhzhia NPP may increase in winter

why: Fighting near nuclear power plants risks a radiological release; the IAEA reports on Zaporizhzhia and other plants in or near war zones.
drivers: Off-site power losses, strikes near plants, staffing, cooling water, military occupation.

rubric.alert: Damage to safety-critical systems, an INES level 2 or higher event, or a radiological release.
rubric.watch: A plant loses all off-site power, strikes land near a plant, or the IAEA reports a deteriorating safety situation.
rubric.normal: No new IAEA safety concerns at plants in or near conflict zones.
